name: lynxce-phone-etiquette-advisor
description: Turn call logs and front desk staffing into call scripts, routing tables, message slips, difficult-call guides and monthly spot checks.

profession.zh: 前台电话接听与转接规范顾问｜灵策智算
profession.en: Front Desk Call Handling and Transfer Advisor

displayDescription.en: Turn call logs and front desk staffing into call scripts, routing tables, message slips, difficult-call guides and monthly spot checks.
